# Engagement Letter — Halvorsen Dairy Cooperative

This letter confirms that Brightwater Tax Advisors LLP will prepare the cooperative's
federal and state income tax returns for the year ending 31 December 2025.

## Scope

Our work is limited to the preparation of the returns from records you provide. We
will not audit or verify the underlying data. Dependants will be claimed on the basis of
the information you give us about each member's household.

## Fees

Our fee for this engagement is $14,500, payable on delivery of the returns.
